subject: Integration commercial terms: onboarding retainer, demo credits, and lead-claim timing
messages:
From: Lucy Harper <lucy@octant.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner commercial summary + a couple clarifying q's

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday — excited about the integration we sketched out. Attached is a very short commercial summary so you have the rough asks in one place (draft-commercial-summary.pdf). A few clarifying questions before we lock anything down with legal: 

1) Onboarding retainer: are you expecting this to be refundable / applied against first invoices?
2) Lead registration window: what counts as an "intro" and how long can we claim priority? We generally ask for 90 days but can be flexible.
3) Demo / POC credits: will those be one-offs or renewable year-over-year?

High level asks from our side: 60/40 rev-share on resale where Octant resells the integrated product, standard referral fee for pure intros that end up buying directly from Redwood, a small onboarding retainer to cover SLAs and joint integration work.

If it's easier, I can drop in a short matrix showing reseller vs referral flows. Can Camila and/or Markus confirm the above assumptions?

Thanks,
Lucy
--
Lucy Harper
Head of Partnerships | Octant AI
lucy@octant.ai
(415) 555-0124

P.S. attaching the summary now.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Harper <lucy@octant.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner commercial summary + a couple clarifying q's

Lucy — thanks for the concise note and the PDF. Looping Marissa for commission ops visibility. Replies inline: 

Onboarding retainer: our standard is a one-time onboarding retainer that is applied to the partner's first settlement invoice (i.e., it's creditable, not refundable unless we mutually cancel before work starts). Typical range we propose is $10k–$20k depending on the size/scope — for the Octant integration I'd recommend $15,000 applied to the first statement. We'll capture that in the term sheet and invoice at kick-off.

Lead registration window: we require registration in the Partner Portal with supporting evidence (intro email thread or CRM sync) within 30 days of first intro. Once registered, the claim window is 12 months for any closed-won business that credits to that registration (we maintain a qualification checklist to avoid duplicate claims). If registration happens after 30 days, it's evaluated case-by-case and will not get auto-claim priority.

Demo / POC credits: we can offer an initial set of demo credits (two full POC credits or up to 80 engineer hours) for the first 12 months after onboarding. These do not roll automatically year-over-year, but partners can request renewal during annual business review with performance metrics.

Commercial splits (suggested):
- Resale (Octant as reseller): 70/30 gross revenue split to Redwood/Octant for co-sold customers where Redwood invoices and hosts the service.
- Referral (passive intro): 15% of first-year net revenue as a referral fee, paid within 60 days of customer payment and net of refunds/discounts.

Clawback: 12-month clawback on credits/commissions for refunds/cancellations (pro rata).

Other notes: tech integration credit — we can allocate up to 40 hours of engineering support (applied as cost credit) for the initial connector build; additional work will be time-and-materials or via a scoped SOW. We also require basic listing in our partner directory and a co-marketing playbook / SFDC lead flow to be agreed on.

I've attached a first pass term sheet (partner-term-sheet-v1.docx). Legal will likely redline the standard MSA — anticipate a follow-up from our legal team next week. If that sounds OK, can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call Wed/Thu to lock ranges and next steps?

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Lucy Harper <lucy@octant.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner commercial summary + a couple clarifying q's

Thanks Markus — that's very helpful. Quick follow-ups from our side: 

- Regional exclusivity: Octant is asking for non-exclusive status but with first-right-to-pursue in a specified vertical (fintech) for 12 months. Are you open to a vertical carve-out (non-exclusive overall, but we get priority for fintech introductions we register)?
- Co-marketing funds: can we include a marketing development fund (MDF) commitment for the first 12 months (e.g., $10k) tied to joint webinars / case studies?
- Demo credits rollover: can unused demo credits be banked for the partner for up to 6 months? If not, we'll push for a partial rollover.

Also — curious about invoicing cadence on reseller deals (monthly vs quarterly settlements) and if there's any minimum commitment threshold before reseller status kicks in. We want to avoid operational friction in the first 90 days.

If it helps, we can take the term-sheet and mark the fintech carve-out and MDF ask as specific redlines for legal to consider.

Best,
Lucy

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Harper <lucy@octant.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner commercial summary + a couple clarifying q's

Lucy — great, appreciate the specificity. Responses below and next steps: 

- Exclusivity / vertical priority: we can do non-exclusive plus a documented vertical priority for fintech for 12 months provided Octant registers fintech opportunities in the Partner Portal within our 30-day window and meets a minimal pipeline milestone (e.g., 3 registered, qualified opportunities in the first 90 days). We'll add a clause to the term sheet that gives Octant first-right-to-pursue on registered fintech leads for 12 months.

- MDF: Redwood can commit to a one-time MDF of $10k for co-marketing activities tied to mutually agreed plans (webinar + one case study). MDF will be reimbursed against approved invoices or credited against partner settlements after activities complete.

- Demo credits rollover: we can allow up to a 3-month carryover of unused demo credits (not the full 6 months) to balance our support load. If Octant wants a 6-month rollover, that would need to be traded for slightly higher first-year MDF requirement or a lower reseller split.

- Invoicing cadence & settlement: reseller payouts settle monthly with a 30-day payment term after invoice; referral fees are paid within 60 days of customer payment. Reseller status requires a signed reseller addendum and a minimal initial intake (the onboarding retainer above). No revenue minimum to start, but certain incentives (e.g., higher split tiers) require reaching revenue thresholds that we'll document in the tier schedule.

Next steps: legal will review the term sheet with the fintech carve-out, MDF language, and demo-credit rollover options. I'll send the partner-portal onboarding instructions (see partner-portal-onboarding-instructions.pdf) and a short checklist we use for registrations. Can Camila pick two times for a joint review with your legal team?

I'll also create a short internal ops note so Marissa can configure the tiered settlements in our payout system once legal signs off.

Best,
Markus
